statement_record.book: Lemma 1.3.8: functors preserve isomorphisms — if f : x → y is an isomorphism in C with inverse g and F : C → D is a functor, then Ff is an isomorphism in D with inverse Fg, by F(g)F(f) = F(gf) = F(id_x) = id_{Fx} and symmetrically.
